Shruman Fungomancer
CR 6

This small humanoid figure stands only about 3 feet tall, with a delicate, bell-shaped cap atop its head that glows with a soft, bioluminescent light. Its translucent skin seems to shift colors subtly, adapting to its surroundings. The creature moves with quick, agile steps, leaving faint trails of glowing spores in its wake.

XP 2,400
Shruman fungomancer 7
N Small plant (fungus, humanoid)
Init +3; Senses low-light vision; darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 14, flat-footed 16 (+3 Dex, +1 size, +5 armor)
hp 52 (7d8+21)
Fort +8, Ref +5, Will +9; Immune mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison, polymorph, sleep effects, stunning; plant traits

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee quarterstaff +5 (1d4-1)
Special Attacks spore cloud (7/day, DC 16)
Fungomancer Spells Prepared (CL 7th; concentration +11)

4th—cure serious wounds, giant vermin
3rd—cure moderate wounds, fungal infestation* (DC 17), plant growth
2nd—barkskin, bull’s strength, lesser restoration, resist energy
1st—charm person (DC 15), cure light wounds, endure elements, entangle (DC 15), pass without trace

* New spell described in fungomancer spell list

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 16, Con 14, Int 13, Wis 18, Cha 12
Base Atk +5; CMB +3, CMD 16
Feats Brew Potion, Craft Wondrous Item, Extend Spell, Natural Spell
Skills Craft (alchemy) +11, Heal +14, Knowledge (nature) +13, Perception +13, Spellcraft +11, Survival +14; Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth
Languages Common, Sylvan
SQ bioluminescence, fungal affinity, fungal companion, fungal form (1/day), fungal symbiosis, mycelial bond (2/day), mycelial whispers (1/day), adaptive pigmentation

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Bioluminescence (Su)

The fungomancer can emit light as the light cantrip at will and alter the color as a free action.

Adaptive Pigmentation (Ex)

Once per day, the fungomancer can change light patterns to blend with surroundings, granting a +10 bonus on Stealth checks for 1 hour.

Spore Cloud (Su)

The fungomancer can generate a 10-ft. radius cloud of spores. Effects: obscuring, irritating, illuminating, healing, or hallucinogenic.

Fungal Form (Su)

The fungomancer can transform into a Small or Medium fungal creature 1/day for 7 hours.

Mycelial Bond (Su)

The fungomancer can tap into mycelial network 2/day for 1 minute to gain tremorsense (30 ft.), +4 Survival, or telepathy (100 ft.).

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate or warm forests
Organization solitary, pair, or circle (3–8)
Treasure NPC gear (quarterstaff, +1 leather armor, cloak of resistance +1, other gear)

A shruman fungomancer leverages its unique abilities and spellcasting to control the battlefield from a safe distance. It opens combat by using its spore cloud ability to create advantageous terrain, often obscuring itself or disorienting enemies. The Fungomancer then relies on its plant growth and entangle spells to restrict enemy movement, while using its fungal infestation spell to deal damage and potentially incapacitate foes. If threatened, it uses barkskin for protection and may transform into a fungal creature using its fungal form ability to escape or reposition. The Shruman takes advantage of its mycelial bond to gain tactical information about its surroundings and coordinates with allies using telepathy when possible.

In prolonged engagements, it uses its healing spells to support itself and its allies, while employing its adaptive pigmentation and stealth bonuses to avoid direct confrontation.
